skills.name: LYGO LLM Console 1.5.6 — PC LOCAL installer (ALPHA, light, picture engine inside)

The console with the picture engine inside — stable-diffusion.cpp's CPU build, no CUDA, no card, no admin — so a machine that has nothing else can still draw. 1,105,316,942 B. 1.5.6 is the release where the RAG index write stops racing itself: one temp path per write plus a write lock, so a busy console stops printing "could not write the index" on a healthy day, and a fresh install no longer prints it on first boot either; the picture engine and the SD 1.5 checkpoint still travel inside as before.
